objective: Run one no-training live mechanics gate on exactly four distinct A100 GPUs over all 32 source-and-donor-disjoint mechanics rows. Keep the native target RWKV/projected carrier fixed; accumulate frozen receptance/address identity evidence causally across full-attention layers 5, 11, 17, and 23; route four ephemeral exact-zero-key virtual positions only during a cached Q=1 predictor call; and require source identity, state/address separation, permutation, zero, cache, state, and predictor-materiality controls before any causal, generation, native benchmark, or Full-Bandwidth feedback access.

launch_binding.two_commit_firewall: Commit the finalized runner, protocol, and tests in one code commit whose exact parent is runtime_parent_commit. Then create and sign only the launch file in its immediate child commit. Before mechanics bytes open, require HEAD parent to equal the authorized code commit, the code parent to equal runtime_parent_commit, the launch commit diff to contain only the launch path, runner/protocol/launch bytes to equal their bound git objects, all dependency hashes to match, and the tracked worktree to be clean.

architecture.name: causal_prefix_depth_accumulated_routed_virtual_kv_live_q1
architecture.accumulated_bias: 32.0 times the arithmetic mean of complete causal-prefix local scores
architecture.virtual_keys: exact all-zero tensors; identity enters only through the additive virtual-mask suffix
architecture.virtual_values: deterministic frozen state-only probe/MLP of the shadow RWKV matrix
architecture.provider_attachment: after an independent provider-detached cached prefill and only for the final prompt predictor token
architecture.cache_mutation: real positions only; virtual slots are appended after cache publication and never persisted

value_builder.status: frozen deterministic mechanics wiring only; no semantic-value or quality claim

candidate_and_control_bank.distractors: minimum source from the first two sorted donor components other than the target/donor component
candidate_and_control_bank.layer_roll: use the same source's state and/or address from module (anchor_layer - 1) modulo the full ordered 42-module inventory
candidate_and_control_bank.provider_disabled: two independent provider-detached cached prefill and Q1 executions for the same repeated target batch
candidate_and_control_bank.full_null_reference: diagnostic-only independent monolithic provider-disabled forward through predictor position with the same explicit positions; exact-v5 hybrid full-prefix and cached execution are not assumed chunk-equivalent

hard_invariants: all 32 unique rows and eight rank-stride rows per GPU
strict router begin then 5 to 11 to 17 to 23 then end lifecycle
exactly two byte-identical live RWKV receptance reads per anchor
independent recomputation from frozen map tensors, shadow addresses, and live receptance of local scores, causal-prefix accumulation, active mask, and scale-32 suffix bias
virtual keys exact zero and real input-mask prefix exact
address-only control leaves virtual values exact and changes bias
state-only control changes virtual values and leaves layer-5 bias exact
joint slot permutation permutes bias and values and preserves final logits within tolerance
zero state and zero address make slots inactive; zero-address and zero-both raw bias exact zero
zero controls are byte-exact to the same-batch provider-disabled predictor logits
each anchor cache grows by one real position, keeps its prefix bytes exact, and never stores four virtual slots
live RWKV state, projected keys, projected carrier values, occupancy, and model parameter versions remain unchanged
two independent same-batch cached provider-disabled prefill and Q1 executions are byte-exact
all tensors finite and no write, training, generation, adapter save, or feedback path runs
required_gates.quality_metric_policy: Target-token logits and CE may be reported diagnostically, but no direction or quality threshold is permitted in this mechanics gate.

execution.model_replication: one complete unsharded model replica per rank/GPU

data_lifecycle.protected_access_order: signed protocol and launch preflight, model/map/builder validation, immediate all-rank source and state revalidation, then one primary-rank mechanics bundle byte open followed by control-group broadcast

stopping_rule.preflight_failure: Open no mechanics bytes; repair only operational/source-binding errors under a newly signed protocol or launch.
stopping_rule.mechanics_gate_failure: Retire this exact cumulative scale/maps/value-builder/control family. Do not tune on mechanics outcomes, rerun, or open causal, generation, native benchmark, or Full-Bandwidth data.
stopping_rule.operational_failure_after_open: Archive the partial signed artifacts and require a separately signed amendment that preserves the architecture and gates.
stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only drafting a fresh causal endpoint protocol. Native benchmark, generation, Full-Bandwidth feedback, benchmark gain, and SOTA remain unauthorized.
